preconditions.description: The length of str1 must be between 1 and 100.
The length of str2 must be between 1 and 100.

preconditions.expression: all(c in '*#@' for c in str1) and all(c in '*#@' for c in str2)
preconditions.description: All characters in str1 and str2 must be either '*', '#', or '@'.

postconditions.description: The output must be the maximum number of bridges that can be built between str1 and str2.
